system.description:
Grit; 6 Blunt; Near (15 ft). Reload: needs an Interact Action to reload after each Strike. Spray'n'Pray: every other enemy within 5 ft of the target must pass a CR 1 Luck Check or also be hit by the Strike.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.144
